name: dsh-desktop-light-spot
preamble: A cohesive set of calm front-facing spot icons for DSH Desktop, matching its real macOS light interface: precise near-black outlines, white and mist-grey surfaces, restrained DeepSeek blue inserts, generous negative space, and a subtle translucent material inside blue details. The icons feel like polished product illustrations rather than toolbar glyphs. Never use a dark canvas or a dominant black filled mass.

construction.grid: one centered front-facing object per cell, about 72 percent live area with generous padding
construction.stroke: one uniform medium near-black outline with rounded caps and joins
construction.fill_rule: white or mist-grey primary surfaces with small pale-blue and DeepSeek-blue inserts
construction.color_rule: near-black is outline and tiny detail only; pale blue is the largest accent; saturated blue stays small
construction.detail_budget: one metaphor and no more than five visible component groups per icon
construction.shared_parts: reuse the same rounded window, card, capsule, and connector geometry
construction.perspective: flat front view with only a slight layered offset for depth
construction.shadow: no shadow cast on the background; a faint internal material highlight is allowed
construction.motif: one small paired curved notch, inspired by the DSH whale tail, appears as a secondary signature
construction.weight_hierarchy: the near-black outline defines the set; blue fills remain lighter and visually subordinate
